name: Quantum Business Law
blurb: Business Law / Wills & Estates in Markham.
about:
Quantum Business Law is a Markham firm whose lawyers work on tax planning, business law, estate planning and litigation for business owners and families. Its tax planning practice covers estate freezes and corporate reorganizations, tax-efficient corporate structures that protect assets from creditors, and succession planning for the next generation.

The firm also acts in tax disputes with the Canada Revenue Agency, in civil litigation such as shareholder and investor disputes and breach of contract claims, and in class action matters. Todd Louie, a senior partner, has more than 30 years of experience as a tax practitioner, and Jonathan Burshtein, a partner, helps with business purchases and sales, shareholder and partnership agreements, family trusts and Wills. The office is in Markham on Renfrew Drive, and the firm lists its hours as Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
